## Checklist

- [ ] Python and JS SDKs changed together (or this only touches one on purpose)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `pytest -m "not live"`, `mypy --strict`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
- [ ] README / package READMEs updated if the public API changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md entry under the next version
- [ ] No keys, secrets or private audio URLs in code, tests or screenshots
